|lore=Son of Anakin Skywalker. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Honed piloting skills while bullseyeing womp rats in Beggar's Canyon aboard T-16 skyhopper.
|game_text=You may activate 1 extra Force each turn if Luke is not at a Tatooine site. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition &lt; 3.
|errata_history=[[Decipher]] published replacement game text for [[Luke Skywalker]] in [[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 89. It changes the activation condition from being present at a non-Tatooine location to not being at a Tatooine site, extends the piloting bonus from a starship to anything he pilots, and replaces “On Red 5” with “When piloting Red 5”. The English [[Luke Skywalker (Reflections Foil)|Reflections foil]] physically prints this revised text.<ref name="decipher-1998">[http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], [[Decipher]] (November 1998), pp. 1–2 and 89. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="wording-faces">Printed faces: [[:File:Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-Foil-PSA.jpg|English Reflections foil]] and [[:File:Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Japanese Reflections III foil]].</ref>

The later digital face and high-resolution reconstruction use different wording: “While Luke is not on Tatooine your total Force generation is +1.” This wording appears in the [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1|PC Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1]] (July 2007). It is not the literal text published in the November 1998 Glossary. The Card Text section retains that Decipher text.<ref name="pc-2007">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1], [[Players Committee]] (July 2007), Appendix A, PDF p. 106, Luke Skywalker. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki copy: [[Media:AR-version-1-7-1.pdf]].</ref>
